top_band: light pink/salmon seat top (rows 7-8) and backrest top (row 2)
evidence: Looking down the center column: rows 2-5 form the backrest (face-on cushion with a 1px highlight on left/top), row 6 is a dark seam, rows 7-10 form the seat cushion. On the seat cushion, row 7 is a 1px light pink highlight and row 8 is salmon with light pink side edges, followed by darker red rows 9-10. This reads as a front-facing puffy cushion (or at best a 1-2px rim/bevel on top of a vertical cushion face) rather than a clear horizontal seat surface seen from above.

style.evidence: The armchair uses a 5-step red/pink ramp with a very dark maroon outline and a 2-step brown ramp for the legs. Shading is smooth and pillowy, though slightly simpler and blockier in texture than the Beodeul reference props.
